description: Unit tests for the BestFitBalancer class implementing resource distribution algorithms within the Orleans streaming framework, including various edge cases and invariants.

classes.name: BestFitBalancerTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests verifying the behavior and correctness of the BestFitBalancer algorithm in different scenarios, including resource distribution, order invariance, and edge cases.

methods.name: IdealCaseMoreResourcesThanBucketsTest
methods.description: Tests resource distribution when resources exceed the number of buckets, verifying balanced allocation.

methods.name: IdealCaseMoreResourcesThanBuckets2Test
methods.description: Another test for resource allocation with more resources than buckets, checking balance correctness.

methods.name: IdealCaseLessResourcesThanBucketsTest
methods.description: Tests resource distribution where there are fewer resources than buckets.

methods.name: IdealCaseLessResourcesThanBuckets2Test
methods.description: Alternative test for fewer resources than buckets with different counts.

methods.name: IdealCaseResourcesMatchBucketsTest
methods.description: Tests case where resources count matches bucket count to verify even distribution.

methods.name: IdealCaseResourcesDevisibleByBucketsTest
methods.description: Tests divisible resource counts across buckets for balanced distribution.

methods.name: IdealCaseRangedTest
methods.description: Runs a range of resource and bucket counts to verify distribution across multiple scenarios.

methods.name: HalfBucketsActiveTest
methods.description: Tests distribution when only a subset of buckets is active.

methods.name: OrderIrrelevantTest
methods.description: Verifies that resource and bucket order do not affect the final distribution, testing order invariance.

methods.name: ValidateBalance
methods.description: Helper method that confirms the distribution of resources across buckets meets the ideal balance criteria, checking for duplicates and completeness.
